<thought>To determine the number of CH₃ (methyl) groups, the simplest approach is to obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample and look for signals in the typical methyl region (~0.8–1.2 ppm) with an integration corresponding to three protons. This requires only a single inexpensive measurement.</thought>
